title: Junior Footwear Designer & Product Developer
note: Asks for 1–2 years in footwear or a strong footwear-focused graduate portfolio; on-site five days a week.

facts.summary: Junior footwear designer and developer working directly with the brand's co-founder and creative director.
facts.duties: Sketch and CAD footwear, build tech packs, research trends, run sample schedules with factories, review samples, run fit sessions and keep line sheets and trackers current.
facts.requirements: 1–2 years or a strong graduate footwear portfolio; freehand sketching; Illustrator essential, Rhino a plus; Procreate; knowledge of shoe construction, lasts and materials.
